text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the detailed medical 
examination showed no major issues for <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, feeling responsible for the 
Umamusume who fell ill, Mei Satake began 
to hesitate about continuing her 
activities next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the members believed they would 
stand atop the world on their next 
challenge, and set to work on their 
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We will challenge the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe again next year through this 
project— The baton passed on by Mei Satake 
was firmly grasped in everyone's hands.
